This included assessing the risks associated with these conditions and discussing management options beyond the procedure itself.","motivation":[{"source_type":"policy","span":{"text":"The medical decision making must reflect an independent judgment with risks, data review, and a management plan distinct from the procedure decision.","start_char":407,"end_char":503},"policy_id":"aapc-modifier25-mastery-2026.txt|46557c1b9929","rationale":"The policy emphasizes that medical decision making should address issues beyond the procedure itself, requiring independent judgment and management plans.","entailed_paraphrase":"Medical decision making must show independent judgment with risks, data review, and a management plan separate from the procedure decision."}]},{"criterion":"separate_exam","suggested_addition":"The examination included an assessment of the patient's sensory neuropathy and peripheral vascular disease, which are not related to the plantar callus area addressed by the procedure.","motivation":[{"source_type":"policy","span":{"text":"Exam findings must include observations on at least one body part or condition that is not the procedure site. Generic statements of unremarkable findings are not sufficient.","start_char":263,"end_char":384},"policy_id":"aapc-modifier25-mastery-2026.txt|46557c1b9929","rationale":"The policy requires that exam findings document observations on conditions or body parts not related to the procedure site to support a separate E/M service.","entailed_paraphrase":"Exam findings must include observations on a body part or condition not at the procedure site."}]},{"criterion":"site_specificity","suggested_addition":"The procedure was performed on the plantar callus area, while the E/M service addressed issues related to sensory neuropathy and peripheral vascular disease, which are distinct anatomical sites. Appropriate modifiers should be appended to reflect this distinction.","motivation":[{"source_type":"policy","span":{"text":"When the E/M and the procedure are performed on different anatomic sites, both LT/RT or T1 through T9 modifiers should be appended to the procedure code in addition to Modifier 25 on the E/M service. Site-specific documentation in the encounter note is required.","start_char":1,"end_char":222},"policy_id":"cms-ncci-policy-manual-em-modifier25-2026.txt|70180f64a8a7","rationale":"The policy specifies that when E/M and procedures occur at different sites, documentation must support this with appropriate modifiers to indicate site specificity.","entailed_paraphrase":"When E/M and procedure are at different sites, LT/RT or T1-T9 modifiers should be added, and site-specific documentation is needed."}]}]}
